issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders has a type mismatch: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares '-totalOrders: int' (line 28) while the provided solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) declares 'private long totalOrders = 0;' (line 6). This inconsistency can confuse students about which type to use and may cause reflection-based checks or automated tests that expect an int to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of SealSaloon.totalOrders consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the declaration in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java from 'long totalOrders' to 'int totalOrders' to match the UML in the problem statement, or (B) update the problem statement/UML to specify 'long' and ensure any tests and documentation expect a long. Choose (A) if no large-count justification exists, and update tests/docs accordingly.
